description: This file declares functions and external variables related to the route configuration for HAProxy within a CURL project. It primarily contains include guards, includes for necessary headers, and function/variable declarations relevant to handling HAProxy proxy configurations if proxies are enabled.

methods.name: Curl_cf_haproxy_insert_after
methods.description: Function to insert a proxy filter after a specified filter in the CURL filter chain, used for configuring HAProxy proxies.
